strongest_bounded_proposition: Later nineteenth-century evidence documents debt-bondage/debt-slavery in Kelantan and comparable Malay states, but the bounded packet does not securely establish the same system at exactly 1800.
strongest_unsupported_proposition: Do not back-project late nineteenth-/early twentieth-century Kelantan descriptions into 1800 or equate all debt bondage with chattel slavery.
territorial_practice_summary: Kelantan debt bondage is well documented later in the nineteenth century; exact 1800 applicability remains unresolved.
terminology_category_qualification: Debt-bondage, debt-slavery, debtor-servantship and domestic slavery overlap in historical descriptions but are not analytically identical.
temporal_scope_precision: Target-specific documentary descriptions are later than 1800; broader Southeast Asian scholarship establishes debt as a major route into bondage from 1400–1800.
inference_extent: No inference beyond the stated target/evidence locus.
language_access_limitations: English-accessible research packet only; non-English and non-digitized scholarship was not exhaustively searched.
